content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Jen: hii are you at your desk
Me: yeah stuck here, whats up
Jen: finally taking lunch in like 20 but ugh I have a favor
Me: oh no that sounds serious lol
Jen: kind of, are you good with like cover letter stuff
Me: decent enough, why
Jen: I'm applying for that ops coordinator thing
Jen: internal posting but still need the whole application
Me: oh nice, getting away from micromanager boss?
Jen: exactly lol she doesn't know yet so shhh
Me: lips sealed
Jen: the form itself is easy but my cover letter sounds so stiff
Me: send it over I can look?
Jen: could we actually do a quick call to go through it?
Jen: it's easier than like 50 texts back and forth
Me: yeah totally, when
Jen: I'm still drafting this week
Jen: what about next friday? not this friday, next one
Me: the 10am brain is still fresh kind of time?
Jen: lol yes, would 10am work for you?
Me: yeah that works, phone call?
Jen: yeah just a normal phone call, like 20 mins max
Me: perfect, I can do 10am next friday
Jen: you're the best, I'll send you the draft before so you can skim
Me: yes please do, otherwise I'll just be like uh sounds great
Jen: hahaha I need actual feedback not just vibes
Jen: my cat is currently sitting on my resume printout btw
Me: oh my god not the gremlin sabotage
Jen: she loves paper, she's in full loaf mode on it
Me: tell her this is important career business
Jen: she does not care
Me: did your cheap umbrella survive today? it's so gross out
Jen: omg it's raining again here too
Jen: yeah it's holding up so far, black boring one
Me: good, mine is still in my bag from last time
Jen: smart, I checked forecast and just gave up
Me: same, my shoes are soaked from the walk in
Jen: are you squeaking around the office now
Me: no that's you, I'm doing the wet sock shuffle
Jen: eww worst feeling
Me: I have like 40 unread again too
Jen: ugh same, all cc nonsense from this morning
Me: I just archived half without opening
Jen: wish, mine actually checks if I opened them
Me: still?? you really do need this new job
Jen: literally why I'm applying lol
Jen: the new team is on the second floor, no leaky lobby
Me: oh nice upgrade, no buckets by the elevators
Jen: right?? big selling point
Me: so for the call, do you want me to just mark it up?
Jen: yeah if you can just note anything weird while we talk
Jen: I'm worried I sound too formal
Me: got it, I'll be brutally honest but lovingly rude
Jen: lol perfect, that's our brand
Jen: btw are you doing pasta for lunch or going out
Me: brought leftover pasta actually, finally boiled water
Jen: proud of you, growth
Me: the cat watched me make it last night, judging the whole time
Jen: as she should, armrest stare?
Me: yep full stare from the couch
Jen: creepy little gremlin never misses
Me: okay I need more coffee before my next meeting
Jen: same, I'm grabbing mine then eating at my desk
Jen: I'll send the draft like thursday next week so it's fresh
Me: sounds good, 10am call next friday to review it
Jen: yes thank youuu, lifesaver",
  "writer_note": "Kept their casual, teasing voice from the umbrella and book chats and wove the 10am phone call for next Friday into normal late-morning work talk about lunch, rain, and the micromanager boss."
}
